verdict.rationale: Gitleaks is a local/offline secret-scanning CLI that operates on whatever git repo, directory, or stdin stream you point it at (gitleaks-gh-1/2/3, gitleaks-probe-4/5) — there is no live 'production' service or sandbox/production environment distinction inherent to the product; it has no hosted state, account, or server component to sandbox against. The 'sandbox vs production data' framing is a category mismatch for this kind of static, stateless scanner.
